commit_message: Complete ADR0133 Remote AI Studio browser validation
pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first-release browser validation from current main. Adds deterministic host-owned Remote state, captures the production HTTP/JavaScript companion in Microsoft Edge at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths, hardens visual-validation authoring-tool parsing so blank CI values are treated as absent, isolates the Remote helper Editor from unrelated screenshot/authoring environment variables, and keeps the full-Clippy Animation Set test ordering fix.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because `scripts/ci/**` changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the generated Remote AI Studio screenshots.
